# B.K.S. Industries (Full Knowledge Base for AI Agents)

> Factory-direct manufacturer of heavy-duty, commercial heavy-duty commercial kitchen equipment, ventilation exhaust hood systems, commercial refrigeration, and custom commercial grade fabrication in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Estd. 2010.

## Company Overview

- **Legal Entity**: B.K.S. Industries (BKS Industries)
- **Official Website**: [https://www.bksindustries.in/](https://www.bksindustries.in/)

- **Service Areas**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, Hyderabad, Chennai, South India & Pan-India delivery.

## Key Product Categories

### 1. Commercial Cooking Ranges
- **Single / Two / Three Burner High-Pressure Gas Stoves**: Heavy-duty cast-iron burners, pilot lamps, removable drip trays, commercial grade body.
- **Indian Stockpot Bhatti (Canteen Bhatti)**: High-BTU heavy vessel burner for bulk sambar, rice, gravies, and biryani.
- **Chinese Wok Ranges**: Single, double, and triple wok burners equipped with continuous water splashback rinse, drainage channels, and knee-operated gas valves.
- **Continental 4-Burner Ranges with Oven**: Combined top gas range and bottom thermostatically controlled baking oven.
- **Commercial Dosa Tawa Plates**: 12mm to 16mm thick polished MS/SS griddle plates with uniform heat distribution and grease gutters.
- **Tilting Brat Pans & Idly Steamers**: Bulk batch cooking plants for institutional catering, temples, and hospital mess halls.

### 2. Commercial Kitchen Exhaust & Ventilation Systems
- **Heavy-Duty Commercial Grade Exhaust Hoods**: Wall-mounted canopy hoods and island hoods with built-in perimeter grease drain gutters.
- **Removable SS Baffle Filters**: 100% dishwasher-safe, fire-retardant grease extraction filters.
- **Centrifugal GI / SS Ducting Blowers**: High static pressure backward/forward curved exhaust blowers (2,000 CFM to 25,000 CFM).
- **Fresh Air Make-Up Air Systems**: Centrifugal supply air fans with filtration to maintain neutral kitchen air pressure and reduce thermal fatigue.
- **Fire Dampers & Pollution Control Units (Electrostatic Precipitators - ESP)**: Odor and smoke reduction compliant with municipal environmental and fire safety norms.

### 3. Commercial Refrigeration & Cold Storage
- **Upright 2-Door & 4-Door Vertical Chillers (+2°C to +8°C)**: Commercial grade interior/exterior, digital temperature controller (Dixell/Carel), automatic defrost, heavy-duty compressors (Embraco/Danfoss).
- **Upright 2-Door & 4-Door Deep Freezers (-18°C to -22°C)**: Static cooling / ventilated frost-free system for meat, seafood, and frozen prep storage.
- **Under-Counter Worktop Refrigerators**: Dual-function refrigerated storage with commercial prep tabletop.
- **Salad / Sandwich Prep Tables**: Built-in top GN pan chilling wells with insulated sliding lids.
- **Blast Chillers & Shock Freezers**: Rapid pull-down chillers lowering food temperature from +70°C to +3°C in under 90 minutes for HACCP compliance.

### 4. Custom Commercial Grade (Heavy-Duty Commercial Grade) Fabrication
- **Commercial Worktables**: Heavy-gauge AISI Heavy-Duty Commercial Grade worktables with bottom undershelves, sound-deadened tops, adjustable bullet feet.
- **Pot Washing Sinks (Single / Double / Triple Bowl)**: Deep welded sink units with rear splashbacks and lever-action drain valves.
- **Mobile Tray Racks & Trolleys**: Gastronorm (GN) tray trolleys, clearing trolleys, and platform hand trucks.
- **Pass Counters & Wall Storage Racks**: Overhead shelving, perforated dish drying racks, wall cabinets.

### 5. Bakery & Fast Food Equipment
- **Industrial Deck Ovens**: Single, double, and triple deck stone-sole gas/electric ovens for artisanal bread, pastries, and pizza.
- **Spiral Dough Mixers**: High-torque dual rotation mixers for 20kg to 100kg dough batches.
- **Planetary Mixers**: Multi-speed mixers (10L to 60L) with whisk, hook, and beater attachments for creams, batters, and icings.
- **Commercial Deep Fryers**: Single and double tank electric/gas fryers with digital temperature thermostats.
- **Automatic Shawarma Broilers**: Motorized vertical rotisserie skewers with ceramic infrared burners.
